title: Mental Health First Aid for Older Adults September 21, 2026
summary: Mental Health First Aid for assisting those 65 and older.
description: MHFA for Older Adults is an evidence-based, early intervention training program that teaches how to assist and support older adults who may be experiencing a mental health or substance use challenge. Older adults have high rates of late-onset mental health challenges, like anxiety and depression, and low rates of identification and treatment. Learning Objectives: Learn the unique impacts of mental health and substance use challenges on older adults. Risk factors and protective factors specific to older adults.
